description: The bar chart, titled "better" in the legend, compares the performance of two models—mBERT (light blue) and XLM-R (dark blue)—across nine language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic) on a "task count" metric, where higher values indicate better performance. The vertical axis represents the task count, ranging from 0 to 40 in increments of 10. For each language family, three bars are displayed: mBERT, XLM-R, and a third category labeled "same" (light green), which likely represents tasks where both models performed equally. The chart shows that XLM-R generally outperforms mBERT, with the most significant difference observed in the IE-Slavic category, where XLM-R reaches a task count of approximately 39, while mBERT is at about 12. In contrast, for the IE-Baltic and IE-Germanic categories, mBERT and XLM-R have similar performance, with mBERT slightly higher in IE-Germanic. The "same" category (green) consistently has the lowest or second-lowest task count in most categories, indicating that the models often differ in their performance. The categories are arranged along the horizontal axis in a non-sequential order, and the legend clarifies the color coding for the three performance outcomes.
